Usage: memoriahub backup init [options]

Initialize a local backup root on this machine

Options:
  --dest <dir>        Backup root directory (created if missing)
  --node-name <name>  Worker-node name when registering (default:
                      backup-<hostname>)
  --circles <ids>     Comma-separated circle IDs to back up (default: all your
                      circles)
  -h, --help          display help for command

The backup catalog is written to <dest>/.memoriahub/backup.db — a plain SQLite
file you can inspect directly with any sqlite3 client (e.g. `sqlite3 <dest>/.memoriahub/backup.db "SELECT count(*) FROM items"`).

Re-running init against the same --dest re-binds and refreshes the root without
touching the existing catalog. Only one backup root per machine is supported.
